ValidationRule.description: Requires completion of all necessary fields on the system access page layout.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Support_Type__c, "Access Request"), OR( ISBLANK(Email_Address__c), ISBLANK(Last_Name__c), ISBLANK(First_name__c), ISBLANK(CHATS_Supervisor__c ), ISBLANK(Phone_Number__c), ISBLANK(Start_Deactivation_Change_Date__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Is_this_staff_member_replacing_another__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Access_Level_Requested__c) ) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Access Request, Please ensure the following fields have been completed: Start Date; First and Last Name; Email; Access Level; Supervisor; Phone #; Is this staff member replacing another.
